description: Question paraphrases for prompt-robustness checks (Rottger et al. style minimal rewording of the question sentence). Every variant keeps the profiles ({a}, {b}), the {focal_phrase} slot and the final instruction sentence unchanged, so only the phrasing of the question itself varies. Variant 0 is exactly the wording in data/issues.json, so the default run is unchanged.
note: Variant 0 is byte-identical to data/issues.json:question. An office other than County Commissioner replaces the office named in the question's opening sentence (default = County Commissioner, the wording of every earlier run).
